### Legendary Electromagntic Planet Factory & Legendary Holmium 
**Factorio version:** 2.1

The last version compatible with Factorio 2.0, v1.6, is [available here](https://github.com/niradar/factorio_blueprints/blob/main/blueprints/legendary-emp/1.6.txt).

**Requirements and Notes:**
- All items are normal quality, except for quality modules. The idea is to be able to rush legendary electromagntic planet right when we start the legendary race.
- If you need legendary quality modules, you can use [this blueprint](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OYm5voVv8s_NWx0wkey)
- Input: 8 full stacked green belts of scraps.
- It needs power to start, but after the factory is working, it produce its own electicity.

**To Start:**
- Connect inputs
- Connect to power
- Add 50-100 logistics bots
- By default the factory creates EMPs. If you want the factory to create Holmium instead, change the switch in the constant combinator
- Optional: use the (E) and (H) combinators to set the maximum number of Legendary EMPs and Legendary Holmium to produce

**Updates:**
* **v1.8 - 30/08/2026:** Fixed concrete and refined concrete voiding, added requester chests for normal, uncommon, and rare EMPs brought into the factory, and improved the ice voider to keep working with higher scrap productivity
* **v1.7 - 24/08/2026:** Updated the concrete voiding system to match the Factorio 2.1 changes
* **v1.6 - 1/2/2026**: Power system improvements (prioritized water + restart backups), added (E/H) combinators to cap output, and switched to filtered storage chests for Legendary EMPs/Holmium
- **Update 19/1/2026**: Only description changes, no update to the blueprint
- **Update 9/11/2025**: Fixed a possible deadlock in the blue circuits recycler
title: Legendary Electromagntic Planet Factory & Legendary Holmium
